messages:
infra-bot: Incident created -> elevated 401s from token-service across us-east-1 and eu-central-1. Detected 2623456789. Impact: API requests using freshly minted tokens return 401/invalid_token, private agents may fail to auth. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9981 :rotating_light:

nora (oncall): seeing repeated log lines: `token_validator: token not yet valid (nbf in future)` and `jwt: signature valid but nbf > now`. Correlates with NTP update on our token-service fleet.

devops_jun: confirmed — cluster time drifted +120s after an automated NTP pool switch at 2623456700. Token issuance uses server time for `iat`/`nbf` and validators reject if local time < nbf.

auth_lead: mitigation plan: (1) pause token-service rollout, (2) restart token-service instances after forcing NTP sync to upstream stratum1, (3) temporarily relax nbf tolerance on validators to allow +-180s window. Executing now. ETA 10m.

support_eng: drafting customer note: "We're investigating increased authentication failures (401) for requests using newly issued tokens. Engineers are remediating a time sync issue; updates at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-9981."

devops_jun: forced NTP sync issued to token-service fleet at 2623456860. Rolling restarts of token-service pods started.

nora (oncall): after first wave restarts, auth errors in us-east-1 dropped from 38% -> 6% within 4m. eu-central-1 showing similar improvement after its restarts.

auth_lead: relaxed validator nbf tolerance to 180s at 2623456920 to reduce customer impact while restarts complete. Will revert once clocks stable. Note: this is a risk for replay window — monitoring closely.

infra-bot: Metric update: token issuance success and validation rate improved to 97% across affected regions within 8m post-mitigation.

platform_ops: opened provider ticket to investigate the automated NTP pool switch behavior (SR-99921).

support_eng: sent initial customer bulletin at 2623457005 to affected customers. Offering targeted retries for enterprise customers who saw failed flows.

auth_lead: action items for RCA and follow-up: (1) add preflight time-check in token-service startup (fail startup if clock skew >30s), (2) add synthetic auth canary that requests fresh token and validates it from a separate host post-deploy, (3) add alert when token-validation failure rate >5% for >5m, (4) avoid automatic NTP pool changes during maintenance windows, (5) revert relaxed nbf tolerance after verification. RCA owner: auth_lead. Please publish draft RCA to /docs/incidents/INC-9981 within 48h.

nora (oncall): leaving incident open until clocks validated for 24h and RCA drafted. infra-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (partial). Final update will follow when RCA posted.
